verdict.rationale: Termius documents its own multi-target actions. You can broadcast input to all sessions in a workspace and run snippets on multiple hosts at once. Group-level settings such as jump hosts and defaults apply to every host in a group, and hosts can be bulk-imported from CSV or ~/.ssh. However, there is no evidence of general bulk management of items (multi-select edit, delete, move or tag of hosts, keys or snippets) or of any programmatic interface for AI-driven bulk operations, since the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/move of hosts and keychain items, a programmatic/API path for bulk operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-host execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
